rounds.question: Does the bounded backend contract preserve the API and CLI boundary while enabling the approved browser reactivation?

citations.finding: The current rotation service rejects disabled records before partial merge, so a narrow explicit option is required for browser-only reactivation.
Bearer and CLI callers use the same service without a browser-facade boundary.
The existing browser facade is the sole same-origin UI credential endpoint.
The dialog uses registry-provided modes, sparse same-mode PATCH, complete replacement PUT, and never renders secret values.
